headline: The invoice says the job is finished. It doesn't say if it made money.
"While you're here, can you just..." Done. Never priced.
Bills and timesheets in one pile. The estimate in another folder.
You can't tell which jobs to chase and which to walk away from.
Every finished job comes with an answer, not just an invoice.
You price the next job from what the last one really cost.
Same paperwork. One place to check it.
before: Costs in one pile, the estimate in another. Nobody puts them side by side.
after: Costs sit against the job's estimate, so the check is already in front of you.

headline: Your estimate becomes the budget. Real costs get checked against it.
